quests.instruction: Which one is exactly c, and not a look-alike?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'cee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: That is c. Its name is 'cee', and you can see it at the start of Crab.
quests.funFact: The letters c and h together make a new sound in words like chair and cheese.

quests.instruction: Look closely. Which one is o?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'oh'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: o is easy to spot once you know its shape: a small round circle.
quests.funFact: The words no and go both end with O saying its own name.

quests.instruction: Slow down and find e.
quests.hint: Its name is 'ee'. Think of Elf: which letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: That is e. Its name is 'ee', and you can see it at the start of Elf.
quests.funFact: Capital E and F look alike, but F has no bottom arm.

quests.instruction: Which small letter looks like a small open curve?
quests.hint: Look for the biggest difference between the choices: a stick, a curve, a dot or a tail.
quests.explanation: c is a small open curve. s is different: a small curvy snake.
quests.funFact: Before a, o and u, C usually says 'kuh', as in cat, cot and cup.

quests.instruction: Which one is pig? Look at the letters closely.
quests.hint: Look closely at the letter that changes. pig has p: a stick hanging below the line with a round tummy at the top right.
quests.explanation: pig is spelled p-i-g. The other words use b and d in the same spot.
quests.funFact: In cupboard, the p is silent.

quests.instruction: One letter in this row does not belong: o q q q q q q. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Scan the row from left to right. Which letter appears only once?
quests.explanation: o is the odd one. All the others are q.
quests.funFact: The letters with tails that hang below the line are g, j, p, q and y.

quests.instruction: Which of these is n?
quests.hint: Say its name, 'en', and look for a short line with one hump.
quests.explanation: n: a short line with one hump. A word to remember it by: Net.
quests.funFact: Lowercase n has one hump.

quests.instruction: Spot h among the look-alikes.
quests.hint: Look for a tall stick with one hump on the right.
quests.explanation: h is the letter named 'aitch'. Its shape: a tall stick with one hump on the right. A word to remember it by: Hammer.
quests.funFact: H says 'huh', a soft puff of breath.

quests.instruction: Which small letter has the shape of a tall stick with one hump on the right?
quests.hint: Trace the shape slowly with your finger, then say the letter name.
quests.explanation: h is a tall stick with one hump on the right. n is different: a short line with one hump.
quests.funFact: Hippo, hammer and honey all begin with H.

quests.instruction: Look at the row: k k k h k k k. Which letter is different from the others?
quests.hint: Compare each letter with the one next to it. Where does the pattern change?
quests.explanation: h is the odd one. All the others are k.
quests.funFact: H is letter number 8 of the 26 letters, with 7 letters before it and 18 after it.

quests.instruction: Which word has both u and y in it?
quests.hint: Cross out any word that has only one of the two letters.
quests.explanation: ladybug is spelled l-a-d-y-b-u-g, so it has both u and y. lettuce has only u, and money has only y.
quests.funFact: Long ago, U and V were written as the same letter.

quests.instruction: How many times do you see b in this row? h h h h b b b h
quests.hint: Only count b. Ignore its look-alike, h.
quests.explanation: There are 3 of the letter b in the row. The other letters are h.
quests.funFact: Lowercase b looks like a bat beside a ball: the stick comes first, then the circle.

quests.instruction: Which one is exactly g, and not a look-alike?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'gee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: g is easy to spot once you know its shape: a circle with a tail that curves below the line. A word to remember it by: Ghost.
quests.funFact: Lowercase g has a tail that hangs below the line.

quests.instruction: Which small letter looks like a circle with a tail that curves below the line?
quests.hint: Picture the word Grapes: its first letter has this shape.
quests.explanation: g is a circle with a tail that curves below the line. j is different: a hooked tail below the line with a dot on top.
quests.funFact: In night and light, the letters 'gh' are silent.

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that goes with d.
quests.hint: Some small letters and capitals look alike and some do not. Check the name: 'dee'.
quests.explanation: Capital D, small d. Compare Dice and dice.
quests.funFact: Book titles and storybook characters usually begin with capital letters.

quests.instruction: Look closely. Which one is E?
quests.hint: Say its name, 'ee', and look for a tall line with three arms pointing right.
quests.explanation: That is E. Its name is 'ee', and you can see it at the start of Envelope. A word to remember it by: Envelope.
quests.funFact: Lowercase e looks like a small circle with a line across the middle.

quests.instruction: Slow down and find P.
quests.hint: Its name is 'pee'. Think of Plate: which letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: P: a tall line with one bump at the top.
quests.funFact: Lowercase p and q are mirror twins.

quests.instruction: Find the capital letter that is a tall line with a bump at the top and a leg.
quests.hint: Draw the shape in the air, then compare it with each letter.
quests.explanation: R is a tall line with a bump at the top and a leg. K is different: a tall line with two arms that reach out on the right.
quests.funFact: Rabbit, rainbow and rocket all begin with R.

quests.instruction: Which of these is M?
quests.hint: Its name is 'em'. Think of Map: which letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: M is the letter named 'em'. Its shape: two tall lines with a V in the middle, like two peaks.
quests.funFact: Moon, monkey and mango all begin with M.

quests.instruction: Which one is exactly N, and not a look-alike?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'en'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: N: two tall lines joined by a slanted line.
quests.funFact: N is letter number 14 of the 26 letters, with 13 letters before it and 12 after it.

quests.instruction: Spot O among the look-alikes.
quests.hint: Say its name, 'oh', and look for a big, round circle.
quests.explanation: That is O. Its name is 'oh', and you can see it at the start of Ox.
quests.funFact: The letters 'oo' can say 'oo' as in moon, or a shorter sound as in book.

quests.instruction: Which pair has I next to its small letter?
quests.hint: Find I in each pair. Is the other letter its small twin, or a different letter?
quests.explanation: Ii is a match: I and i are the same letter, 'eye'. The other pairs mix two different letters.
quests.funFact: Every capital letter has a lowercase partner, and every lowercase letter has a capital partner.

quests.instruction: One pair joins T to the wrong small letter. Which pair is it?
quests.hint: Say each letter's name. One pair has two different names.
quests.explanation: jT does not match: T and j are different letters. The other pairs show the same letter in two forms.
quests.funFact: Capital letters are also called uppercase, and small letters are called lowercase.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the same letter as j?
quests.hint: Some small letters and capitals look alike and some do not. Check the name: 'jay'.
quests.explanation: J is the partner of j. It looks like a line that hooks to the left at the bottom.
quests.funFact: Every sentence starts with a capital letter.

quests.instruction: How many times do you see q in this row? q p p q q p q p p
quests.hint: Point to each one as you count so you do not skip any.
quests.explanation: There are 4 of the letter q in the row. The other letters are p.
quests.funFact: The letters 'qu' usually say 'kw', as in queen.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses w and m together.
quests.hint: Spell each word out loud and listen for w, then listen for m.
quests.explanation: worm is spelled w-o-r-m, so it has both w and m. jigsaw has only w, and money has only m.
quests.funFact: W says 'wuh', with rounded lips.

quests.instruction: Find the word lock.
quests.hint: Spell lock out loud: l-o-c-k. Find that spelling.
quests.explanation: lock is spelled l-o-c-k. The other words use d and s in the same spot.
quests.funFact: Lion, lemon and ladybug all begin with L.

quests.instruction: Slow down and find u.
quests.hint: Say its name, 'you', and look for a small cup open at the top.
quests.explanation: u is easy to spot once you know its shape: a small cup open at the top. A word to remember it by: Unicorn.
quests.funFact: After q, the letter u almost always follows, as in queen.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter looks like a tall line with two round bumps on the right?
quests.hint: Draw the shape in the air, then compare it with each letter.
quests.explanation: B is a tall line with two round bumps on the right. S is different: a curvy snake shape.
quests.funFact: Lowercase b and d are mirror images, which is why they are so easy to mix up.

quests.instruction: One letter in this row does not belong: J J J J J I. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Scan the row from left to right. Which letter appears only once?
quests.explanation: I is the odd one. All the others are J.
quests.funFact: The letter i hides in the middle of tiny, big and little.
